Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Minhang Campus)

Address: 800 Dongchuan Road, Minhang District, Shanghai 200240, China [show on Google maps]
Contact: ICBR 2026 Conference Secretariat
Email: ieee.icbr@gmail.com


Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), founded in 1896, is one of China's leading universities, internationally recognized for its excellence in education, research, and innovation. With a long-standing academic tradition and strong global engagement, SJTU provides an ideal environment for international academic exchange and collaboration.
The conference will be held at the Minhang Campus of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, located in Minhang District, Shanghai. The campus provides modern facilities for teaching, research, and academic events, together with a spacious and pleasant campus environment. Further information on transportation, campus access, and the specific conference rooms will be provided before the conference.
